task_title: Floor 2 — favor-based boss-den unlock route (FR13 win-favor)

plan_review.notes: Reviewer examined two concerns: (1) seeding win-favor as a per-family objective vs. a universal bypass. Resolved: win-favor is AI-unreachable (headless AI fights, killMob -5 lowers relation); seeding it per-family stalls AI dens (rule #12 / win-rate gates). Universal bypass is correct. (2) Whether a latched favor flag is needed separately from the unlock flag. Resolved: kept distinct for HUD/telemetry to tell 'opened by favor' from 'opened by kill objective'. Both concerns closed; plan_divergence is minor (the seeded-vs-universal axis was the only real fork and was resolved by the AI-unreachable constraint).

rounds.notes: Three findings: (1) CI dead-code check failing — denFavorGoalId and hasEarnedDenFavor exported from floor2Scenario.ts but only consumed by tests and labs (src/labs/ excluded from isProductionSrcPath). Fixed: added both to TEST_SCAFFOLD_ALLOWLIST_ENTRIES with reason and 2026-11-03 expiry. (2) Test calls floor2ObjectiveTick directly, bypassing the real floorObjectiveSystem dispatch path. Fixed: added pipeline-level test using runSimulationStep with postSystems: [floorObjectiveSystem]. (3) FR13 spec lists win-favor as a seeded objective, conflicting with the universal-bypass implementation. Fixed: revised FR13 to document two separate routes with rationale.

independent_grade.notes: Diff reviewed: floor2Scenario.ts adds denFavorGoalId, hasEarnedDenFavor, seeding, and tick latch. Lab adds win-favor action + per-family row. Integration test covers 5 direct-tick cases + 1 runSimulationStep pipeline case. Allowlist entries are time-bounded with correct reason strings. FR13 spec revised to distinguish the two routes. No invariant breaks, no Math.random(), no Date.now(), no layer-boundary violations. AI-only path unaffected; latch cannot re-seal. Scope_discipline docked 1: spec revision shifts win-favor from seeded to universal without a formal ADR. Policy_compliance docked 1: original 2-apple declaration was under-declared (corrected to 3-apple in this recovery).
